name: Ragnarok-like Pixel
description: A detailed Ragnarok-like pixel-art theme. The actor/rig uses the chibi reference; the icon, object, surface, tile, portrait and silhouette sections carry the family instructions.
palette: skin #F2C79A highlight #FFE0B8 shadow #C98B60; hair #4A2A1C / #7A4A2E / #A8673E; tunic #2F5FA8 / #1C3A70 / #6EA8E8; outline #1A1210; eyes #3B6FD6 / #FFFFFF; boots #5A3A22.
positive: Chibi proportions: a large head, a small body and short limbs. Bright saturated palette with strong warm/cool separation. Thick dark outline around the silhouette. Soft two-tone shading with one clean highlight. Large expressive eyes. Front-facing, centred, the soles of the feet at the bottom of the frame. Crisp pixel-art shapes, readable at a glance.
negative: Do not use dark muted realism, realistic adult proportions, photorealism, scenery, floor tiles, text, multiple characters, blurry anti-aliasing, or a perspective that contradicts the front-facing world.

inventory_icon.positive: Readable at 32x32: a single centred symbol, clean monochrome warm-grey line art with one consistent dark outline, flat two-tone interior, generous transparent padding, no colour accent, no background, silhouette first.
inventory_icon.negative: Do not use text, labels, backgrounds, drop shadows, gradients, multiple objects, coloured fills, or thin broken lines.

resource_icon.positive: A single bold resource symbol at 32x32, monochrome with a consistent dark outline, transparent background, high contrast at small size, same visual family as the inventory slot icons.
resource_icon.negative: Do not use text, numbers, backgrounds, gradients, or fine detail that disappears below 24 pixels.

skill_icon.positive: One centred subject at 32x32, flat two-tone colour with a dark outline, readable silhouette, transparent background, consistent warm palette, simple motion or impact cue only when the skill needs it.
skill_icon.negative: Do not use text, frames, busy backgrounds, photographic detail, gradients, or more than one focal object.

status_icon.positive: Readable at 32x32: a single centred symbol, clean monochrome warm-grey line art with one consistent dark outline, flat two-tone interior, generous transparent padding, no colour accent, no background, silhouette first.
status_icon.negative: Do not use text, labels, backgrounds, drop shadows, gradients, multiple objects, coloured fills, or thin broken lines.

portrait.positive: Character portrait with a consistent painted pixel style, clear face and shoulders, warm limited palette, dark outline, transparent or simple neutral backdrop, readable at HUD size.
portrait.negative: Do not use text, multiple characters, busy scenery, or a different rendering style from the world sprites.

object.positive: Top-down three-quarter game sprite, 32x32, compact centred silhouette, warm limited palette, one-pixel dark outline, transparent background, readable at a glance, modest highlight and shadow.
object.negative: Do not use text, UI frames, large empty backgrounds, photorealism, or a perspective that contradicts the top-down world.

surface.positive: Transparent tile overlay at 32x32, shape fills the cell without a hard border, readable colour and silhouette, edges feather into transparency, same limited palette as the world sprites.
surface.negative: Do not use text, opaque backgrounds, rectangular frames, or hard cell borders.

tile.positive: Top-down 32x32 ground material, fills the whole canvas edge to edge, warm limited palette, subtle small-scale texture, low contrast so entities read over it, no strong object silhouette.
tile.negative: Do not use text, props, walls, characters, large highlights, or transparent edges.

silhouette.positive: Front-facing transparent body outline, thin consistent monochrome line, head at top and feet at bottom, symmetrical readable silhouette, no clothing or equipment, generous empty margin, 64x96 canvas.
silhouette.negative: Do not use text, fill colour, shading, clothing, background, or equipment.

effect.positive: One centred subject at 32x32, flat two-tone colour with a dark outline, readable silhouette, transparent background, consistent warm palette, simple motion or impact cue only when the skill needs it.
effect.negative: Do not use text, frames, busy backgrounds, photographic detail, gradients, or more than one focal object.
